title: Select a compatible motor driver for the reference pump fixture
objective: Select one candidate motor driver that satisfies the supplied electrical constraints and produce a traceable decision explaining why the rejected candidate failed.

in_scope: Evaluate only the synthetic candidates and measurements supplied in the fixture.

deliverables.description: An approved selection decision naming the compatible candidate.
A summary of the startup-current verification and relevant limitations.

constraints.statement: The selected candidate must support the supplied 12 V fixture.
The selected candidate peak-current capability must cover 18 A for 0.8 s.

success_criteria.statement: The approved decision selects a candidate that passes both voltage and startup-current checks.
success_criteria.method_hint: Evaluate the pinned candidate data with the validated fixture rules.

success_criteria.statement: The result reports the verification method, evidence, and limitations.

prohibitions.statement: Do not present the synthetic fixture result as certification or advice for a real product.
Do not purchase, install, or operate hardware.
